name: Multi-Resolution Volumetric Mapping with Haar Wavelets
aliases: Multi-resolution volumetric mapping with Haar wavelets
definition: A volumetric mapping method that uses Multi-Resolution Analysis (MRA) conditions to store only the differences between resolution levels using wavelet decompositions, avoiding redundant storage of lower-resolution information.
summary: Multi-Resolution Volumetric Mapping with Haar Wavelets maintains 3D occupancy maps by performing sensor updates directly in a compressed wavelet domain, implicitly synchronizing all resolution levels without manual maintenance passes.
